verification.method: scripts/verify/trade-117.py reads the original World Bank zips (data/raw/wdi/), not the site's generated data; check-wdi.mjs compares all 212,284 generated WDI values with the original files; then the text was read by hand
verification.against: World Bank WDI bulk files and indicator metadata (update 11 November 2026, CC BY 4.0; national accounts data)
verification.what: every ranking row (171 economies, order and value), the CSV, every figure in the text, FAQ, title, description and JSON-LD; claims: ranking year 2024 by country coverage, China, US, Germany top, top-ten share 48.8%, Luxembourg, Hong Kong, Singapore highest share of GDP, world share 12.8% in 1970 and 29.1% in 2024, Bangladesh 64th and below its 2022 level, UAE/Qatar/Nigeria unranked; definitions from the World Bank indicator notes
verification.result: All automated comparisons matched; 2025 was not used for the ranking because only 138 economies have a 2025 figure while the World Bank's gap-filled world total runs ahead
